# Roles and capabilities (C024, C042, C009-IMP-02)

Default deny. No wildcard, no inherited administrator. Host capabilities belong only to `node-helper`. Two-person actions: artifact.promote, config.activate, egress.policy.update, emergency.enable, rollback.execute.

| Role | Actions |
|---|---|
| workload | session.create, session.exec, session.inspect, session.stop, session.teardown |
| scheduler | session.create, session.inspect, session.stop, session.teardown |
| operator-read | diagnostics.read, session.inspect |
| operator-contain | emergency.disable, node.quarantine, session.freeze, session.inspect, session.quarantine |
| policy-editor | config.activate, egress.policy.update |
| release-manager | artifact.promote, rollback.execute |
| break-glass | emergency.disable, emergency.enable, node.quarantine, rollback.execute |
| node-helper | host.cgroup.write, host.kvm.open, host.overlay.mount, host.tap.create |
